column1: # Rename table for WORK-common step 2.  Columns: old, new, optional note.
# Whole-word identifiers, and include paths (rows whose old ends in .h or .c, applied
# to #include lines and Makefile lists; --move also does the git mv).
# Lines starting with # are comments.  Reviewed against doc/STYLE.md before applying.
# include guards: VCC_<MODULE>_<NAME>_H, every header under include/common and include/port
# text buffer (the emitter's fixed reservation): tb_* -> vtext_*
# soft float (f128.h): q_*, qb_* -> vsoftfloat_*; p suffix = precision parameter
# job regions, performance counters, stack guard, file mapping
# step 6: the two "vmreg ..." output strings in port/job-regions.c keep their text in this step.
# step 4: vhash_obj and vhash_strtab (different bodies), vbuf_s, vsbuf_str, vfixbuf_puts (types merge).
# unlikely_vi stays: the existing `unlikely` is defined per includer, not visible where intern.h is used.
# NOT in this table (need code, not a rename): __crc32cd/__crc32cb -> vcrc32c_u64/u8 on both hosts
# (arm64 uses the ACLE intrinsics of the same name; hostcrc.h must define the new names there first),
# struct fields with clipped names (by hand, with their module), x86features.h / x86native.h (x86_*).
